Agent Browser 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback.
- Enables AI agents to navigate, interact with, and extract data from web pages using structured commands.
- Supports advanced web automation features: navigation, interaction (click/type), snapshots, form filling, testing, screenshots, PDF generation, video recording, and more.
- Includes semantic locators, state management, network controls, and storage/cookie handling.
- Provides a comprehensive command suite for browser control via CLI.
